title: Nazi Zombie Ali (ZCT)
author: nikfar1, 2012; ships the ZCT MOD2_MW mod alongside
notes: THE ENDING IS IN THE CO-SHIPPED MOD, NOT THE MAP. The folder holds three different maps/_zombiemode.gsc: one in nazi_zombie_ali.ff, one in nazi_zombie_ali.iwd, and one in zombie_clinic.iwd (the ZCT MOD2_MW mod the README says the map needs). The engine printed zombie_clinic.iwd FIRST on the search path, so its 69,495 B copy is the one that runs. Only that copy contains the ending: _zombiemode.gsc:114 threads end_game_trig(), which finds every trigger_use with targetname 'end_game' and runs end_game_trigger() - a 20,000-point 'GET OUT OF CLINIC' purchase (the cost is hardcoded in script, NOT a zombie_cost key) that sets level.tom_victory = true and calls end_game(). end_game() then sets level.intermission AND level.finalcutscene and shows 'YOU WON' instead of 'GAME OVER'. So the detector is level.tom_victory, with the trigger+intermission pair as a fallback. The map's own 50,000-point zombie_door (target auto215) is just an expensive door - a plausible-looking false positive that cost me an hour before referee/scan_map.py found the real one. The advertised '6 piece of amulet' quest still does not exist in any script: not detectable, deliberately not listed as an easter_egg. zombie_clinic.iwd also overrides maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, _laststand.gsc, _loadout.gsc and _gameskill.gsc, so re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on this map. The mod folder ships gift.exe - never run it (dev-box.md rule 3).
event_model: signal ids follow IW4MAdmin feature/zombie-stats EventLogType where one exists; see docs/kickstart/referee.md section 6
